commit_subject: (screen-flagged) Fail closed: adds la_2026_resident_filing_status_selection_valid guard to every joint-status branch of Louisiana 2026_resident_core (logic/polarity).
description: Re-review found one conflicting-status component leak; the fix requires both valid status and joint for every spouse branch.

triage.pre_fix_wrong_because: The three spouse branches keyed only on the raw `la_2026_resident_filing_status_joint` input flag, so a return with a contradictory filing-status selection (the IT-540ESi line 3 list is five mutually exclusive statuses, and the module's own `filing_status_selection_valid` requires exactly one) still received the joint-return-only spouse disability exemption, active-duty exclusion and volunteer deduction — failing open on a return the encoding elsewhere treats as having no valid filing status, and on which the source gives no basis for counting spouse facts.
triage.triage_notes: Single rule module in the commit; the same two-line guard (`if la_2026_resident_filing_status_selection_valid and la_2026_resident_filing_status_joint`) is added to three separate rules in one file — identical hunk shape each time. Companions changed alongside it are mechanical: the companion fixture file (which flips the `conflicting_filing_statuses_fail_closed` fixture's spouse inputs from false/0 to true/6000, true/50000, true and adds assertions that `la_2026_resident_disability_income_exemption`, `la_2026_resident_active_duty_outside_louisiana_exclusion` and `la_2026_resident_volunteer_deduction` are all 0) and the `.axiom/encoding-manifests` hash file. Provisions read through the pinned corpus: La. R.S. 47:44.1(B) reads "Six thousand dollars of annual disability income received by an individual shall be exempt from state income taxation" (per-individual, so a second allowance depends on the spouse being on the return, i.e. a joint return), and the 2026 IT-540ESi worksheet line 3 enumerates Single / Married Filing Joint / Married Filing Separate / Head of Household / Qualifying Surviving Spouse as one choice. Caps are 6000, 50000 and 500, so under a conflicting-status return up to $56,500 of spouse amounts leaked; `la_2026_resident_partial_tax_table_income_before_held_adjustments` already failed closed on invalid status, so the leak surfaced in the exempt-income / deduction component outputs (which are asserted fixture outputs and feed the oracle surface) rather than in the partial tax figure. This commit is a pre-merge repair round inside PR #1026 (parent f1ed255931 is on the same branch), following an earlier round that first gated spouse items on joint returns at all; a later repair in the same PR replaced a flattened EITC rate import, unrelated to this module change. Main doubt for a reviewer: an alternative kind is wrong_entity_or_scope (joint-only spouse items applied to a return that is not validly joint), and a strict reader could call this defensive hardening against an input state the form forbids rather than a direct disagreement with source text — I kept polarity_or_logic because the kind list explicitly places fail-open vs fail-closed there and because the commit subject is "Fail closed Louisiana spouse components".
triage.verifier_justification: The diff changes executable boolean logic in three formulas, adding `la_2026_resident_filing_status_selection_valid and` as a conjunct to the joint-only spouse branches of the disability exemption, the active-duty-outside-Louisiana exclusion, and the volunteer deduction, and the companion fixture flips from spouse flags false to true on the `filing_status_selection_count: 2` case while newly asserting all three components equal 0 — so encoded meaning, not bookkeeping, changed. The pre-fix module was internally contradictory against its own source-anchored filing-status rule: `la_2026_resident_filing_status_selection_valid` (proof-atomed to the IT-540ESi line 3 list, which the resolved corpus text confirms enumerates Single / Married Filing Joint / Married Filing Separate / Head of Household / Qualifying Surviving Spouse as one mutually exclusive choice) already forced the standard deduction and partial tax-table income to 0, and the parent file's own summary already asserted "Filing status fails closed unless exactly one recognized status is selected" — while these three branches still paid out on a contradictory selection. That is precisely the fail-open-vs-fail-closed / mis-combined-`and` case, which the kind list places under polarity_or_logic, and the commit subject "Fail closed Louisiana spouse components" names it directly.
triage.verifier_notes: Refutation attempts that failed: (1) "Defensive hardening for an impossible input, so an enhancement rather than a defect" — killed by the parent file, which already documented the fail-closed contract in `module.summary` ("Filing status fails closed unless exactly one recognized status is selected") and already implemented it at `la_2026_resident_standard_deduction` and `la_2026_resident_partial_tax_table_income_before_held_adjustments`; the three spouse branches simply did not honor a contract the module had claimed. The five status flags are raw undeclared inputs (they appear only inside `la_2026_resident_filing_status_selection_count`), so the contradictory state is representable and the fixture exercises it. (2) "Mechanical" — rejected; the only bookkeeping is the manifest's two applied-file sha256s plus generated_at/tmpdir, which follow the real formula change. (3) "reclassify to wrong_entity_or_scope or unrepresented_clause" — considered, since the defect does concern filing status and does add a conjunct; rejected because the joint-scope condition was already present and correct for well-formed returns, the added guard is an already-encoded, already-source-proved predicate rather than a newly represented source clause, and the failure mode is exactly the fail-open default the polarity_or_logic definition enumerates. Genuine caveat for the reviewer, the reason confidence is not higher: the blast radius is confined to the three component outputs, because `la_2026_resident_partial_tax_table_income_before_held_adjustments` already returned 0 on an invalid selection, so the module's headline partial income and 3% tax figures were unaffected pre-fix. The wrong values were nonetheless published on declared module outputs ($6,000 / $50,000 / $500 for a return the encoding elsewhere treats as having no valid status), which is what the new fixture assertions pin. Provenance note: the defect and the fix both live inside PR #1026, which introduced the module, so this never reached main in the broken state; the quoted "Re-review found one conflicting-status component leak" line is the PR's own narrative of its review-fix cycle, and it matches the diff exactly. Post-fix grep confirms no bare `if la_2026_resident_filing_status_joint` joint-only payout branch remains (lines 365 and 423 are the status counter and the standard deduction, which is already inside a `selection_valid` gate), so the PR's "every spouse branch" claim holds.
